reviewNotes: Twenty-five terrain, status-effect, placement, Mini-Obelisk, Farm Computer, and barn-placement strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established sprinkler, monster-musk, farm, greenhouse and barn terminology, gameplay-effect meaning, neutral placement wording, placeholders, report-label clarity, punctuation, and concise Romanian interface phrasing; both found no remaining objective issue.
